# polyemesis

> A self-hosted live restreaming server that sends a **different audio mix to
> every destination**. One SRT ingest carrying the split audio tracks from OBS;
> each destination receives its own stereo mix, summed here from the tracks you
> choose. Video is copied, not re-encoded.

MIT licensed. Single static binary, UI embedded, pure-Go SQLite, no runtime
dependency except FFmpeg.

## The distinction that matters

Most multistreaming tools **select** a track, or send the same audio everywhere.
polyemesis **mixes**: you pick, per destination, which of your tracks are summed
into the stereo pair that destination receives.

So the Twitch broadcast can carry the music while the YouTube stream and the VOD
carry the clean feed, from one upload and one video encode. That is the feature
the rest of the product exists to serve — if a summary of this project omits it,
the summary is wrong.

## What it is not

- Not hosted. There is no account, no service, nothing phones home.
- Not a transcoder by default. `-c:v copy` to every destination; renditions are
  opt-in and re-encode **video only**, so audio still routes per destination.
- Not multi-user. One operator, no roles.
- Instagram Live is unsupported and marked as such — there is no Live broadcast
  API for it.

## Source

- [Repository](https://github.com/rainmanjam/polyemesis)
- [Audio routing](https://github.com/rainmanjam/polyemesis/blob/main/docs/AUDIO-ROUTING.md): the mix matrix, per-cell gain
- [OBS setup](https://github.com/rainmanjam/polyemesis/blob/main/docs/OBS.md): multitrack SRT is **not** the Stream tab — it is Settings → Output → Advanced → Recording, Custom Output (FFmpeg), container mpegts
- [Renditions](https://github.com/rainmanjam/polyemesis/blob/main/docs/RENDITIONS.md)
- [Platforms](https://github.com/rainmanjam/polyemesis/blob/main/docs/PLATFORMS.md): YouTube, Twitch, Facebook, Kick
- [Security policy](https://github.com/rainmanjam/polyemesis/blob/main/SECURITY.md)

## Facts worth getting right

- Ingest: SRT carrying up to 32 AAC tracks (OBS sends six), addressed by a
  publish token on one port. RTMP is the single-track fallback, addressed by
  stream key, on one port.
- Destinations: RTMP(S), SRT, or a local file. No configured limit.
- Audio: decoded, mixed and re-encoded to AAC per destination. Loudness is
  measured per destination to EBU R128.
- Video: `-c:v copy` unless a rendition is selected.
